messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout v5.0.0 -> 10% (us-east-2, eu-central). Change window 01:00-03:00 UTC. Health checks: 10m. Release notes: <internal/release/5.0.0>

rachel: Seeing a small but consistent rise in 5xx from the edge in us-east-2 since 01:12 UTC. 0.05% -> 0.6% in 8m. No alerts yet but trend looks correlated with rollout start.

tom: I can confirm increased tail latency on session-store in us-east-2. Service logs show 'session affinity miss' errors intermittently. Could be sticky-cookie parsing change in this release.

lucas: We changed session cookie serialization to base64url in 5.0.0 to avoid padding issues. Maybe older clients still send padded cookies. Parser should be tolerant.

rachel: Suggestion: PAUSE further percent ramps, PIN us-east-2 back to v4.9.7 while we hotfix parser to accept padded base64. Avoid full rollback in other regions.

oncall-bot: @tom, @lucas 1: oncall is tom. Pager notified.

tom: I'll run the pause + pin now. Commands: `deployctl rollout pause --version=5.0.0` and `deployctl pin --routes=us-east-2 --version=4.9.7 --reason="session affinity errors"`. Execute if approved.

devops-bot: Note: pinning preserves current healthy connections for pinned routes. Increased latency on ephemeral sessions may persist for a minute.

lucas: Approve. I'll open hotfix PR to add padding-tolerant decode and a feature flag to toggle new cookie format. ETA ~15m.

tom: Executing pause & pin. exec-id: exec-20260323-777.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by tom (exec-20260323-777). Pins applied: us-east-2 -> v4.9.7.

rachel: Pins confirmed. Creating incident INC-20260323-90, assign lucas for hotfix.

lucas: PR opened: session-service#258. Running unit + staging smoke. Will post when staging verified for 10m.

tom: Monitoring: 5xx rate in us-east-2 trending down after pin. Good so far.

rachel: Decision: STOP ramp. Pin region to stable. Hotfix + staging validation. Re-evaluate for a safe 2% reintroduce afterwards with the feature flag.

devops-bot: Reminder: update release notes to reflect pinned region and plan for a gated canary on flag toggle.

deploy-bot: Thread closed. Reopen for GO when tests pass or if additional action required.
